description: Isolates hexadecimal case alone. The sha256: prefix is exactly right and the digest is exactly 64 hexadecimal characters; only the hex digits are upper-case. invalid-non-canonical-content-hash.json also upper-cases the prefix, so on its own it cannot tell a case-insensitive [0-9a-fA-F]{64} pattern from the released [0-9a-f]{64} one.
